how.title: Your first employee in five steps.

steps.title: Hire
steps.text: Pick a role and write its goal in numbers.

steps.title: Set the schedule
steps.text: Choose its working hours and how often it wakes up.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Plug in the Claude Code or Codex you already use.

steps.title: Assign
steps.text: File issues on the board and assign them to it.

steps.title: Approve
steps.text: Answer its messages when it needs you. That's it.

items.a: Crewmark turns Claude Code and Codex agents into AI employees. Each employee has a role, a goal measured in numbers, working hours and a heartbeat: it wakes on a schedule, takes the next issue from a kanban board, comments as it works and messages you when it's blocked. It runs on the subscription you already pay for.

items.q: Do I pay for tokens on top?
items.a: No. Your employees run on the Claude Code or Codex subscription you already have, so there is no second bill for tokens.
Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness and OpenCode. Each employee runs inside the real agent, so the work is as good as the agent itself.
How often an employee wakes up during its working hours. Every 30 minutes, for example, it checks the board, takes the next issue and carries on.
Nothing. The employee sleeps until its next shift starts, so it never burns through your plan at three in the morning.
You write the target in numbers, like 10% more Search Console clicks a month. The employee plans its work toward it, and you can see how close it is.

items.q: Can I talk to an employee in Claude Code?
items.a: Yes. Chat with it in Claude Code Desktop, Codex Desktop or Crewmark; the conversation is the same session in every place.

items.q: Can I check on Claude Code from my phone?
items.a: Yes. Claude Code's own Remote Control lets you continue a session running on your computer from your phone; see <guide>how Claude Code Remote Control works</guide>. A Crewmark employee goes a step further: it keeps working on its heartbeat while you're away, and messages you when it needs you.
It sends you a direct message: a question, a review to look at, or a permission to grant. The issue waits on the board until you answer.

cta.title: Your first AI employee can start today.
cta.text: Hire one in a few minutes with the Claude Code or Codex you already have, and give it its first issue.
